assumptions: Capacitor A has the stated capacitance and the source maintains 9.0 V across it.
Stored charge means the magnitude of the charge on either capacitor plate.

defect_reasons.contradictory_distractor_statement: Every variant reports two incompatible values for the same charge on C2, without stating a physical change or explicitly correcting the first value.

notes: All four variants give Q_A = 0.00090 C. C2 is structurally disconnected (D), so its charge does not affect this result. Nevertheless, the respective charge reports for C2 contradict each other: 0.0003 versus 0.0006 C; 0.0006 versus 0.0012 C; 0.0009 versus 0.0018 C; and 0.0012 versus 0.0024 C. These contradictions invalidate every variant under admission rule 2. Across variants the distractor values change, but their wording, units, and attachment remain the same.
